Privacy in this review

A factual description of the current guest and browser storage boundary.

Local project storage

Project manifests, edits, checkpoints and saved resource collections use browser storage on this origin. Export your project to retain a portable copy. Clearing browser site data removes local records.

Credentials

Core browsing, composition, editing and export need no provider key. BYO provider credentials must remain ephemeral and are never written to project manifests, D1 or R2.

Hosting

ChatGPT Sites serves the site and receives ordinary page and asset requests. Review the hosting provider privacy policy for its processing. Tessellate does not add third-party analytics, advertise fabricated usage counts or provision an additional database for this review.

Public previews

Resource previews use sandboxed frames without same-origin privileges. Treat all example content as synthetic demonstration data, not real employee records.
